title: Refactoring UI
blurb: Read over two weeks while rebuilding this site's earlier drafts.

lines: Read over two weeks while rebuilding this site's earlier drafts.
hierarchy is a budget: not everything can be important, so decide
what is and spend visual weight there. Most bad interfaces are just
start with too much whitespace, then take it away. Dense screens are
easier to tighten than airy ones are to fix.
don't scale everything linearly with font size — padding, borders and
icon weights need their own curves or the proportions collapse at small sizes.
depth is a cue, use it once: pick shadows or borders or overlap,
